about_the_game:
Roguelike... but this time, with a squad of heroes.

In 7 Squad, you’re not the lone hero anymore. You begin with one cheerful champion and gradually assemble a squad of up to seven charming, weird, and wildly different heroes—each with unique powers and personality.

As the chaos unfolds, every new teammate unlocks exciting synergies and transforms your strategy. Dodge swarms of enemies, combine abilities on the fly, and adapt your team to survive the madness. With every run, your squad becomes stronger, sillier, and more satisfying to control.

If you’re into fast-paced bullet-hell, roguelike replayability, and managing a lovable crew of tiny heroes—7 Squad is calling your name.
